summary: Read bank transfer receipts an owner shares in the assistant chat (photo or PDF) with OpenAI, then match them to an owing order, a transfer between the business's own accounts, or money out, and draft the existing reviewed action. Nothing is recorded until the owner confirms. Telegram now downloads a single photo or PDF sent to the bot and stores it as the chat's attachment so the same receipt flow runs; other media keeps the text-only reply.

capabilities.note: Receipts in chat draft this existing action with the receiving account, the receipt facts in its note and an optional receiptAttachmentId; on confirm the receipt joins the order's Notes & photos through the existing order_attachment_add executor. Roles, procedure, review lines and rollout are unchanged.

docs.note: Receipts draft existing actions (payment_record, money_transfer_simple, expense_record_simple, money_movement, sale_record, customer_receipt) through their existing permission checks and reviews. No capability is added or released.

evidence.result: 6 tests, 20 assertions pass: amount parsing, reference normalization, strict parsing, model allowlist, PDF as file input with usage, provider failure.
15 tests, 34 assertions pass: names, masked account numbers, own transfer, money out purpose, order match by number/remark/sender/typed name, part and excess payment, unknown account, unreadable.

Guarded development QA (ewatrade_qa_v1, own QA business, removed after): receipt matched by sender, payment confirmed with the receipt kept on the order, duplicate refused, unknown sender asked then matched by typed name, own-account transfer, money-out expense, purpose question, unknown account, not-a-receipt, unreadable, and Telegram photo and PDF stored as ready attachments then read. Provider read and Telegram download synthetic. 1 test, 26 assertions pass.
Media turn and channel proposal review suites: 14 tests, 98 assertions pass with the inert database URL.
Telegram parser and webhook suites: 16 tests, 89 assertions pass; a single photo or PDF carries its file, albums, voice notes and other files do not.
All API Telegram unit suites: 61 tests, 236 assertions pass.

Live Development turn (14 Nov 2026) as the Claude Web Test Farms QA owner: a rendered transfer receipt was read by gpt-4.1-mini (1,695 input / 138 output tokens), matched to ORD-035 by sender name and to GTBank current account by account number, and drafted payment_record with the receipt attached; review lines were the 5-line native shape. Proposal left to expire unconfirmed. Turn 17.7 s.
15 tests, 38 assertions pass, including bank names printed with the account number (GTBank |, 9PSB, Xpress masked).
